description: This file defines the cSettings class, which manages configuration settings stored in a JSON-like structure, including reading from and writing to a file, and provides methods to get, set, check, and remove key-value pairs.

classes.name: cSettings
classes.description: A class for managing configuration settings stored in a JSON object, with file persistence.

methods.name: cSettings
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the settings object, creating the file if it does not exist.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given key.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair with string, int, or bool value types and writes to file.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists and is non-empty.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from the settings.

methods.name: writeToFile
methods.description: Serializes the JSON data to the configuration file.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Initializes the JSON object from the configuration file.
